command: uv run --python python3.13 python scripts/run_relation_feasibility_audit.py --extractor agent --cases scripts/validation/relation_feasibility/fixtures/biomedical_relation_goldset_v2.json --output-dir reports/relation_feasibility/2026-07-02-pr3-entailment-verifier-agent-strict
environment_note: Local strict-agent run on 2026-07-02. OpenAI API key was unavailable to the extractor, so all agent-mode cases used unavailable/fallback diagnostics and the verdict is RED. PR-3 treats that as expected evidence that live agent quality is still unproven while the support-verification gate itself is now measurable and fail-closed.

summary.verdict_reason: 30/30 cases are invalid because agent extraction did not complete without fallback.

implementation_evidence.support_verifier: Document extraction support now exposes a fail-closed, direction-aware triple support verifier with ENTAILS, NEUTRAL, and CONTRADICTS outcomes plus a model-adapter port.
implementation_evidence.proposal_metadata: Document extraction proposals now include metadata.support_verification only when the PR-2 grounding gate passes; ungrounded candidates omit the key instead of pretending support was checked.
implementation_evidence.contradiction_floor: Contradicted candidate support floors confidence and ranking_score to 0.1 and annotates metadata.support_verification_floor=contradiction.
implementation_evidence.trust_floor: Candidate extraction trust metadata now requires support_verification.support=ENTAILS before trusted_evidence_eligible can remain true.
implementation_evidence.graph_hard_floor: The graph service now rejects AI-authored evidence-requiring claim and canonical relation writes unless metadata.support_verification.support=ENTAILS.
implementation_evidence.audit_gate: The feasibility audit counts entailment_required, entailment_checked, and entailment_supported candidates, and a required candidate is valuable only when support verification returns ENTAILS.

blocking_findings: Role-blind heuristic support could treat reversed active triples as ENTAILS.
Ungrounded candidates received NEUTRAL support_verification metadata, making skipped checks look like completed checks.
Graph promotion and validation enforced grounding but not entailing support at the persistence boundary.
Passive-direction evidence could still entail the reversed triple.
Promotion request metadata could overwrite verifier-owned evidence_grounding or support_verification fields.
fixes: Direction-aware support verification plus reversed-direction regression coverage.
Support metadata is omitted when structured grounding fails.
Graph AI evidence validation now requires support_verification.support=ENTAILS for claim and relation writes.
Passive cue spans can no longer take the active subject-to-cue-to-object path.
Promotion request metadata is filtered so reviewer-supplied metadata cannot replace verifier-owned fields.
adversarial_review.residual_non_blocking_risk: The verifier remains deterministic and heuristic unless a model adapter is supplied, so broader semantic nuance remains a later quality problem. No remaining route was found for unsupported, co-mentioned, reversed, or request-overridden evidence to become valuable or trusted under the PR-3 invariants.

known_remaining_risk: The support verifier in this slice is conservative and deterministic unless a model adapter is supplied. It closes the measurement and trust-gating hole, but live agent quality remains unproven until agent extraction completes without fallback.
